headline: Dh2.1 trillion in projects under way: Mohammed bin Rashid says Dubai is entering a new era of growth and development
summary: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid said Dubai has Dh2.1 trillion in projects under way, including investments in real estate, aviation, transport and infrastructure. He said the emirate is entering a new era of growth.
why: Dubai's large infrastructure and real estate pipeline drives construction, tourism and investment flows in the United Arab Emirates economy.
